pathogenesis: a result of significant heart disease, leading to a decrease in blood flow to the body and low blood pressure. caused by chronic illness that leads to significant issues causing the heart to be unable to pump enough blood || any disease that multiplies the amount of blood in the ventricles(s) which leads to a greater amount of blood flow and can cause congestive heart failure. this includes valve disease and left-to-right shunts || chronic disease that leads to a significant reduction in the heart's contractions, significant regurgitation or shunting or significant diastolic dysfunction
diagnostic_methods: clinical condition, symptoms include coughing, shallow rapid breathing, swelling, weakness, weight loss || heart murmur and rapid heart rate || throbbing of the jugular vein
